text: Tokyo and Hakone with friends, 2026-12-05 to 2026-12-09, 3 people
draft:
I'll load the city skills and search hotels for both bases in one go.# Draft itinerary — Tokyo & Hakone with friends (5–9 Dec 2026)

**Overview**: Tokyo 2 nights → Hakone 2 nights → back to Tokyo/Haneda on the last day | 1 hotel change | light · standard · standard · tiring · light

Nights split 2 + 2 so nobody sleeps in a city for a single night. Hakone is reached by Romancecar from Shinjuku, so a Shinjuku-side base in Tokyo keeps the transfer simple.

**Before you go**
- Book the Odakyu Romancecar (Shinjuku → Hakone-Yumoto) seats a few weeks ahead — reserved seats sell out in December; please check current timetables.
- Reserve any timed-entry places you want (e.g. teamLab, Shibuya Sky sunset slot, Ghibli Museum) a few weeks ahead; please check availability.
- Get an IC card (Suica/PASMO) at the airport for JR, subway and buses.
- On Day 3, forward luggage from the Tokyo hotel to the Hakone hotel with takkyubin (arrange the day before) and travel with a small bag — the Hakone Tozan line and cable car are cramped with suitcases.
- December is cold (Hakone can be near freezing at night): pack layers; check the weather for Mt Fuji views.
- A JR Pass is not needed for this route — compare only if you add long Shinkansen legs.

**Day 1 | Arrival · Shinjuku (light)**
- 14:00 Haneda Airport → Keikyu Line to Shinagawa, approx. 20 min, no transfer (from Narita: Keisei Skyliner to Ueno, approx. 45 min, then JR approx. 20 min)
- 15:30 Check in, rest
- 17:00 Shinjuku Gyoen area walk or Omoide Yokocho for an early dinner — Shinjuku Station is huge, allow extra time to find exits
- 19:30 Golden Gai for a drink, early night
- Tonight: Shinjuku Washington Hotel Main (新宿华盛顿主酒店)

**Day 2 | Shibuya · Harajuku · Omotesando (standard)**
- 08:30 Meiji Jingu (JR Yamanote to Harajuku, approx. 10 min, no transfer): calmest early morning
- 10:30 Takeshita Street and Omotesando, walk approx. 15 min
- 12:30 Lunch in Omotesando
- 14:30 Shibuya: crossing and a rooftop view at dusk (Ginza Line 1 stop, approx. 5 min)
- 18:30 Dinner in Shibuya
- Alternatives: if rain, Shibuya department stores and a museum instead of the Omotesando walk; if tired, drop Takeshita Street
- Tonight: Shinjuku Washington Hotel Main (新宿华盛顿主酒店)

**Day 3 | Tokyo → Hakone · Gora (standard)**
- 09:00 Forward luggage, then Shinjuku Station → Odakyu Romancecar to Hakone-Yumoto, approx. 85 min, no transfer
- 11:00 Hakone Tozan train to Gora, approx. 40 min, no transfer; drop bags at the hotel
- 12:30 Lunch in Gora
- 14:00 Hakone Open-Air Museum (walk approx. 10 min from Gora)
- 17:00 Check in, onsen before dinner
- Alternatives: if rain, the Open-Air Museum's indoor Picasso pavilion and the hotel's baths instead of the sculpture garden; if tired, drop the museum
- Tonight: Hakone Gora Onsen Tokinoyu Setsugetsuka (箱根强罗温泉季之汤雪月花)

**Day 4 | Hakone loop · Lake Ashi (tiring)**
- 08:30 Gora → cable car and ropeway to Owakudani, approx. 25 min, 1 transfer: volcanic valley, clear-morning Fuji views
- 10:30 Ropeway to Togendai, approx. 20 min, no transfer
- 11:00 Pirate ship across Lake Ashi to Moto-Hakone, approx. 30 min
- 12:30 Lunch at Moto-Hakone; Hakone Shrine and the lakeside torii, walk approx. 15 min
- 15:30 Bus back to Gora, approx. 40 min, no transfer
- 17:30 Onsen and dinner at the hotel
- Alternatives: if rain, skip the lake crossing and do the Hakone Sekisho checkpoint and the hotel onsen instead; if tired, drop the shrine and return from Togendai by bus
- Tonight: Hakone Gora Onsen Tokinoyu Setsugetsuka (箱根强罗温泉季之汤雪月花)

**Day 5 | Departure (light)**
- 09:00 Breakfast and a last onsen
- 10:30 Gora → Hakone-Yumoto by Tozan train, approx. 40 min, then Romancecar to Shinjuku, approx. 85 min (or Odawara → Shinkansen if flying from Haneda via Shinagawa, approx. 35 min + approx. 20 min)
- Leave plenty of time for check-in; please check the exact train times before you go

Hotel prices shown are the lowest rates found for 3 adults over each stay and can change — please confirm when booking.
